name: Who remembered the road
text:
The road was here before us.
Our mothers and fathers walked it.
Theirs walked it before them.
We walk it now.
Do not ask who made the road.
Ask who remembered it.
For when the stones disappear
and the grass covers the footprints,
the road remains
inside the memory of the people.

inspired_by.source: Rigveda 10.14, the path the Fathers took
inspired_by.note: Original composition after Rigveda 10.14, the path the Fathers took. Not a translation, and not a quotation.

notes: Edited from the owner's draft: "Our fathers ... Their fathers" made ungendered.
